title: Runner contract: report checkpoints and thread entries

story.i_want_to: report each commit I push as a checkpoint and each reasoning note as an entry over the runner channel
story.so_that: the thread fills as the work happens rather than being reconstructed afterwards

rationale: The runner is the only party that knows when a checkpoint exists; PRD §3 and §4 item 2.

acceptance_criteria.description: Runner contract minor bump adds optional checkpoint and thread_entry messages; a runner that sends neither message gets today's behaviour. The review dispatch kind is not part of this bump: it arrives with US-45.3, which places the review dispatch.

A checkpoint carries dispatch_id (which names the story; a story id is never taken off the wire), claim_epoch, commit_sha, tree_sha and an optional note; loopctl derives the parent from the previous checkpoint of the same claim and records it through the same function as US-45.1 with the same epoch fence.
A thread_entry message carries a client_seq; its idempotency key is dispatch_id:client_seq.
priv/runner_contract/v1.json is regenerated and its changelog names the version and both messages.

test_cases.name: contract carries the messages
expected_results: version bumped; both messages declared optional

technical_notes: Runner adoption happens in mkreyman/loopctl-runner by handoff.
